d:
Ten years after the original Himalayan 411, Royal Enfield has arrived at its biggest Himalayan yet. The new Himalayan 750 brings an all-new 743cc parallel-twin engine, a fresh chassis and a more road-focused adventure touring character.
We rode it in Sicily, and the first impressions are promising. The engine is refined, the 224kg motorcycle feels surprisingly nimble on the move, and its highway manners make it a natural fit for long-distance touring. There are a few things to iron out, though, particularly the suspension setup and some software niggles.
